## Description (first paragraph)

**When to use:**
- You have a physical part in hand (broken, legacy, undocumented) and need a CAD model
- A blueprint is missing or unreadable — but you can take photos / record a turntable video
- You want a parametric scaffold that the operator can refine with caliper measurements
